params.body:
Follow-up to #369.

#369 added `observatory` to Intelligence's default abilities. On the box, though, the offer saved on Settings > Plans dates from before that change, and a saved plan's `abilities` replace the defaults completely. So live, Intelligence still did not open the Observatory:
- gentells.com did not show the new Observatory link (site #229);
- an Intelligence account was refused at the Observatory's login with "This account has no access to the Observatory".

Checked on the box: `getPlans().plans.intelligence.abilities` is `latest, archive, sources, graph, reports, context, team`.

Change: `normalize` now always adds `observatory` to Intelligence, the same way it already forces `latest` onto every plan. The projection sends the corrected offer at the next sync, and the site follows it.

Tests: a saved Intelligence without `observatory` still opens it, and Decode still does not. That test fails without the fix. Full suite 1337/1343; the 6 failures are the known report-render tests that need pdftoppm.

params.title: Intelligence opens the Observatory whatever offer is saved
